title: Adaptive sprint lifecycle
objective: Make Kyro record changing work truthfully without treating a partial sprint or exhausted roadmap as a terminal scope failure.
successCriteria: Every unfinished task has a typed, reasoned disposition before sprint closure.
Closing any sprint preserves immutable evidence while keeping the scope open for explicit next planning.
Scope completion and retirement remain explicit, distinct decisions.
Doctor and Integrity distinguish lawful lifecycle evolution from immutable-artifact corruption.
Legacy checkpoints remain readable without retroactive semantic claims.

requirements.statement: Kyro SHALL require an explicit validated disposition for every unfinished task before closing a sprint.
requirements.rationale: Unfinished work must remain discoverable and attributable instead of being represented as success or silently discarded.

requirements.statement: Kyro SHALL close a sprint without automatically completing its scope merely because all originally planned roadmap entries are closed.
requirements.rationale: A roadmap is an estimate; scope completion requires an explicit decision and evidence.

requirements.statement: Kyro SHALL allow an open scope with no active sprint to plan a subsequent sprint through the normal tool-owned flow.
requirements.rationale: Legitimate reprioritization must not require a recovery or manual state edit.

requirements.statement: Kyro SHALL preserve fail-closed validation for immutable checkpoints, unsafe paths, identity conflicts, and stale approvals while accepting lawful lifecycle evolution.
requirements.rationale: Simplification must not weaken artifact integrity or recovery safety.

requirements.statement: Kyro SHALL keep retirement distinct from scope completion and preserve readable historical checkpoint semantics.
requirements.rationale: Terminal retirement has explicit human approval semantics, and immutable historical bytes cannot be rewritten.

scenarios.given: an active sprint has unfinished tasks
scenarios.then: each unfinished task must carry a valid explicit disposition with its reason and any required continuation reference

scenarios.given: the final originally planned sprint has a mixture of completed and disposed tasks
scenarios.then: the immutable close record reports a truthful partial outcome and the scope is not automatically completed

scenarios.given: an open scope has closed all originally listed roadmap sprints
scenarios.when: the user supplies a later sprint plan
scenarios.then: kyro plan materializes it through the normal tool-owned route without recovery

scenarios.given: a scope contains either lawful lifecycle evolution or an unsafe/corrupt immutable artifact
scenarios.then: lawful evolution is distinguishable from scoped fail-closed artifact corruption

scenarios.given: a historical or retired scope is inspected
scenarios.then: historical records remain readable and retirement remains explicitly terminal and human-gated

scenarios.given: an open scope has no active sprint, no unresolved debt or review, and healthy artifacts
scenarios.when: the user explicitly confirms scope completion
scenarios.then: Kyro records completion as a distinct lifecycle fact without retiring the scope or rewriting its archive

scenarios.given: a completed but non-retired scope needs later work
scenarios.when: the user explicitly reopens it with a reason
scenarios.then: Kyro preserves completion history and routes the scope to plan_sprint without recovery or manual edits

nonGoals: Startup-contract consolidation or unrelated global preflight redesign.
NutriLens or Kyro Lens implementation changes.
Manual editing mode for Kyro-managed state.
Archive rewriting, release, installation, publication, or version bump.

conventions.rule: A post-close live-state transition is valid only if it replays exactly from the checkpoint after-image through the same builders the writer uses; lifecycle records are evidence, never authority.

roadmap.sizingRationale: The work is sequenced by semantic dependency: define the lifecycle contract first, implement the core transitions second, then reconcile integrity and certify the complete path.

sprints.title: Truthful sprint close and open-scope routing

recommendations: Before completing this scope, verify each success criterion against evidence rather than treating all-tasks-done as proof the objective was met.
If further lifecycle transitions are added (e.g. suspend/resume), extend checkpoints/lifecycle-state.ts and its replay first, then the command surface.

previousSprint.summary: Prove that dispositions, truthful closes, explicit completion, and reopen replay identically through Doctor and Integrity without weakening immutable-artifact safety.

handoff.note: Sprint 3 (integrity-certification) closed as shipped. Scope remains open for planning.
